name: Paylocity
description_en:
Paylocity is a cloud platform spanning HR, payroll, finance and IT. Its Human Resources product focuses on employee data, documents, self-service, position management, workflows and HR support; wider talent, benefits, attendance and other products have their own scope and optional add-ons.

A useful starting point is a specific employee process, such as a transfer or offboarding, and the documents, approvals and records it must update. A broad all-in-one description is not a complete purchasing specification, and public pricing remains quote-based.
description_zh:
Paylocity 是跨 HR、工资、财务及 IT 的云平台。Human Resources 产品重点为员工数据、文档、自助、岗位管理、流程及 HR 支持，更广的人才、福利、考勤等产品有各自范围和附加条件。

评估可从调动或离职等具体流程开始，明确其需要更新的文档、审批和记录。“一体化”描述不能代替完整采购清单，公开价格仍需询价。

core_features.explanation_en: The HR page describes unlimited custom fields with text, dropdown, number, date and checkbox types.
core_features.explanation_zh: HR 页面描述不限数量的自定义字段，类型包括文本、下拉、数字、日期和复选框。

core_features.explanation_en: Centralize offer, tax and exit documents, while employees access pay forms, request leave and update personal details.
core_features.explanation_zh: 集中录用、税务及离职文档，员工可访问工资表单、申请休假并更新个人资料。

core_features.explanation_en: The process engine offers templates such as offboarding and routines customized to the organization.
core_features.explanation_zh: 流程引擎提供离职等模板，并支持按企业需要定制处理过程。

pricing.summary_en: Customized module quote; numeric rates, implementation charges and minimum term not disclosed. Limited new-payroll promotion is not a sustained free HR plan.
pricing.summary_zh: 按模块定制报价，未披露费率、实施费及最短期限。新工资客户限时优惠不是长期免费 HR 套餐。

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Specify the change before the automation
sections.en: The Human Resources page describes a searchable document store, custom employee fields and workflows with templates or custom routines. For an illustrative transfer, define the new position, reporting manager, required certification and document, then check the employee and manager views. Position- and seat-level information is distinct from an employee’s current details, so decide which record owns an open position and its budget. The website supports evaluating these capabilities, but does not establish how each effective date, rejected request or historical correction behaves. Those should be shown in the configured tenant.
sections.zh: Human Resources 页面描述可搜索文档库、自定义员工字段，以及模板或定制流程。调动示例可明确新岗位、汇报经理、所需证书和文档，再检查员工及经理视图。岗位和编制信息与现任员工资料不同，需确定空缺岗位及预算由哪份记录管理。网站支持评估这些能力，但未确立各类生效日期、拒批或历史更正的具体行为，需在配置租户中展示。

sections.en: Employee Self-Service gives access to paystubs, tax forms, time-off requests and personal information through desktop and mobile. The HR page separately describes HR Edge resources and an account manager for policies, job descriptions and training, plus an AI assistant for search and company-policy or product questions. These are different operational and advisory capabilities, not evidence of unlimited expert support in every package. Test a confidential document search and a policy question under the relevant role. Regulatory dashboards and AI answers can support work but were not reviewed as legal advice or independently validated compliance outcomes.
sections.zh: 员工自助通过桌面及移动端提供工资单、税表、休假申请和个人信息。HR 页另描述 HR Edge 资源及客户经理，用于政策、岗位说明和培训，也有用于搜索、公司政策或产品问题的 AI 助手。它们是不同的运营及咨询能力，不证明每个套餐均有无限专家支持。应按角色测试敏感文档搜索和政策问题。监管看板及 AI 回答可辅助工作，但本研究未将其作为法律建议或独立验证的合规结果。

sections.title_en: Select modules rather than the entire navigation
sections.title_zh: 按模块采购而非按导航全部计入
sections.en: The pricing page separates HR, Finance and IT and says customers may implement one or more modules. It explicitly names Recruiting, Employee Voice and Learning as optional HR add-ons. Payroll, workforce management, benefits and employee experience are described alongside core HR; the list is not proof of a single all-inclusive subscription. Specify whether attendance capture, shift swaps, payroll filings, benefits feeds or IT access actions are needed, and ask which products and interfaces perform each task. Global payroll promotion should be checked against the actual country and employment arrangement rather than generalized from a country count.
sections.zh: 价格页区分 HR、财务、IT，说明客户可实施一个或多个模块，并明确把招聘、Employee Voice、学习列为 HR 附加项。工资、人员运营、福利及员工体验与基础 HR 并列展示，不能证明一个订阅全包。需明确是否需要考勤采集、换班、工资申报、福利数据流或 IT 权限操作，并询问每项由哪些产品和接口完成。全球工资宣传应对应实际国家和雇佣安排，不能从国家数量泛化。

sections.title_en: Use a written quote and a migration scope
sections.title_zh: 使用书面报价及迁移范围
sections.en: The reviewed pricing page has a request-pricing route but no numeric rate, billing unit, contract minimum or implementation fee. It offers customized implementation and ongoing service without specifying that every service is free or unlimited. Request subscription, add-ons, data migration, interfaces, training, support and renewal terms. The HR page’s one-month-free payroll promotion applies to eligible new payroll-bundle clients with phased conditions; it is neither a free full HR platform nor a general permanent price reduction. No purchase or promotion eligibility was verified.
sections.zh: 所读价格页提供询价入口，没有数值费率、计费单位、最低合同或实施费。它提供定制实施和后续服务，未说明每项服务都免费或无限。应询价订阅、附加项、迁移、接口、培训、支持及续订。HR 页的一月免费工资优惠只针对符合条件的新工资组合客户且有阶段条件，既非完整 HR 免费平台，也非普遍永久降价，未核实购买或优惠资格。

sections.title_en: Verify a corrected record and the exit path
sections.title_zh: 核实更正档案及退出路径
sections.en: Paylocity merits evaluation when a team needs coordinated employee records and several related business processes. A buyer needing only a standalone form or directory should weigh module and implementation scope. Prepare identifiers, position definitions, balances, document access and workflow owners, then test offboarding with an outstanding task and a corrected employee field. Migration should reconcile source totals and employee histories before cutover. Hosting jurisdiction, permission granularity, audit retention, complete exports, failure recovery and source-code licensing remain unverified. No account, workflow, AI answer, payroll or connector was executed.
sections.zh: 需要协调员工档案及多项相关业务流程的团队可评估 Paylocity，仅需独立表单或通讯录的买家应衡量模块和实施范围。需准备编号、岗位定义、余额、文档权限和流程负责人，再测试存在未完成任务的离职及员工字段更正。切换前需核对迁移来源合计和人员历史。托管辖区、权限细节、审计保留、完整导出、失败恢复及源代码许可仍未核实，未执行账户、流程、AI 回答、工资或连接器。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.

research_gaps.en: No tenant, employee change, AI, payroll, export or integration was tested.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试租户、员工变更、AI、工资、导出或集成。

research_gaps.en: Exact module entitlements, quote, promotion terms, hosting, full exports and recovery remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 具体模块权益、报价、促销条款、托管、完整导出和恢复仍未核实。
